import pandas as pd

python -c "
import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_excel('budget.xlsx', sheet_name='Budget', header=None)
exp = df.iloc[10:22, 2].astype(float)

print('Total expenses:', exp.sum())
inc = df.iloc[3:7, 1].astype(float)
print('Income values:', inc.tolist())
print('Total income:', inc.sum())
print('Balance (income - expenses):', inc.sum() - exp.sum())
"
